About

I am a Senior Research Engineer in the Multi-modal Development Team at NHN Corporation, where I lead research and development on generative AI for music and visual content creation. Prior to NHN, I was a Research Engineer at Hyundai Motor Company, working on camera–LiDAR fusion for autonomous driving perception.

My research interests lie in multimodal representation learning, controllable generative models, diffusion models, and latent space geometry. I received my M.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Sungkyunkwan University.
